rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Dmarkoff provides read-only access to DMARC monitoring data through OAuth 2.1-authenticated MCP tools. Fourteen tools expose domain health status, SPF and DKIM authentication results, compliance analytics, and anomaly detection. Access is included with paid Dmarkoff plans and supports MSP use cases for managing multiple client domains.
